integrity: Proof is algebraic over the algebraic closure; finite-field enumeration cross-checks do not substitute for proof. Elliptic quotient isogeny and smoothness criterion are credited to prior work. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns smooth normalized marked Ciani quartic coefficients over characteristic five; does not divide by isomorphisms, count ordinary/rank-two strata, or generalize to other characteristics. Brock (1993) full thesis not inspected; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Six rational low-5-rank curves in the characteristic-five Ciani family
